themes.title: Far-Right Surge in European Regional Elections and Governance
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties in Germany (AfD), France (RN), and Spain (Vox) are either leading polls or pushing hardline policies, with AfD poised to win in Saxony-Anhalt, RN proposing a veil ban referendum, and Vox escalating sovereignty rhetoric over Ceuta. This reflects a coordinated push for nationalist governance and cultural identity politics.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD leads polls in Saxony-Anhalt with 40-42%, threatening to form the first far-right state government in post-WWII Germany. Debates over economic impact, media restructuring, and legal bans dominate coverage.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen proposes a referendum to ban Islamic veils in public spaces, framing it as combating Islamist ideology. The proposal sparks legal and political backlash but unifies the party’s base.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox intensifies rhetoric over Ceuta and Melilla, accusing the Spanish government of betrayal and demanding the suspension of the Spain-Morocco friendship treaty. Mass protests and diplomatic pressure are central themes.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega faces internal rebellion as dissidents revive the Lega Nord brand, challenging Salvini’s leadership. Meanwhile, Fratelli d’Italia celebrates government longevity, signaling stability amid right-wing fragmentation.

signals: internal party rebellion as transnational pattern

themes.title: Immigration and Border Security as Political Wedges
themes.blurb: Vox in Spain and RN in France are weaponizing immigration and border security as central campaign issues, with Vox accusing Sánchez of ceding sovereignty over Ceuta to Morocco and RN proposing hardline measures like veil bans. This theme also appears in Sweden (SD) with anti-immigration messaging.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox dominates discourse on Ceuta, framing migrant inflows as a national security crisis and accusing the government of enabling Moroccan encroachment. Calls for breaking diplomatic ties and mass protests are prominent.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN ties immigration to cultural identity, proposing fines for veil-wearing in public as a way to assert French secularism and combat perceived Islamist influence.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Sweden Democrats use immigration as a key wedge issue, with messaging around crime and integration, including controversial public campaigns (e.g., Stockholm Central Station posters).

signals: shared framing of immigration as existential threat

themes.title: Populist Right Battles Media Bias and Digital Censorship
themes.blurb: The MAGA movement in the U.S. and Sweden Democrats continue to frame mainstream media and digital platforms as biased against them, with narratives of censorship and unfair treatment. This theme persists as a unifying grievance across right-wing movements.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump and allies decry media bias, with outlets like Fox Business and The Guardian covering MAGA defectors and censorship claims. Legal battles over voting rights and data privacy also tie into this narrative.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Sweden Democrats amplify messages of media hostility, including conflicts with public broadcasters and accusations of left-wing bias in coverage.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage’s return to Parliament and clashes with the BBC (e.g., over live-broadcasted criticism) reinforce the theme of media bias against the right.

signals: legal and rhetorical pushback against platforms

themes.title: Nationalist Symbolism and Rebranding of Public Institutions
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in the U.S. (Trump), Hungary (Tisza), and Poland (PiS) are engaged in symbolic rebranding, from renaming institutions to revisiting historical narratives. This includes Trump’s proposed renaming of Lake Ontario and Hungary’s dismantling of Orbán-era structures.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump’s administration and allies push symbolic acts like renaming Lake Ontario to 'Lake America' and proposing a U.S. Space Academy, reinforcing nationalist branding.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: The Tisza government dismantles Orbán-era institutions (e.g., Media Council reshuffles, closing Orbán-backed think tanks) as part of a broader rebranding away from the previous regime.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS emphasizes historical grievances, including demands for WWII reparations from Germany and critiques of German-Polish relations, as part of a nationalist narrative.

themes.title: Economic Nationalism and Trade Disputes
themes.blurb: The U.S. (Trump) and Hungary (Tisza) are pursuing economic nationalism, with Trump imposing tariffs and striking oil deals while Hungary renegotiates EU funds and bilateral economic ties. This reflects a broader right-wing trend of prioritizing national economic interests over multilateralism.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump’s administration imposes tariffs on Canada, strikes oil deals with Venezuela, and meets with oil executives, signaling a protectionist and resource-focused economic agenda.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungary’s Tisza government secures EU funds while criticizing EU financial demands, and renegotiates economic ties with Croatia (e.g., INA-MOL dispute).

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS proposes economic populism, such as increasing school allowances and investigating financial scandals (Zondacrypto) to appeal to nationalist economic sentiment.
